description: Rust backend non-comment, non-observability line baseline for legacy oversized files. Ratchet after calibration: entries may shrink but must not grow.

calibration.reason: Business logging instrumentation introduced repository-wide tracing attributes and events; the structure gate now excludes observability-only Rust lines and this calibration restores the ratchet to the new comparable count mode.
calibration.policy: Future backend changes must not raise these non-comment, non-observability line counts without a separate governance review; shrink or remove entries when files are split.
